findings.summary: Evidence loader accepts an omitted and mutated imported production asset
findings.evidence: Actual dc89 loadV3Evidence export, synthetic temporary loader-unit repository/bundle: full baseline accepted; remove assets/imported.js from manifest.production and recompute declared combined binding with mechanically consistent unit surface inputs: accepted; mutate that file although dist/index.html imports it: accepted. Loader checks only Object.entries(production), never compares keys with actual dist inventory. Diagnostic result: /var/tmp/observatory-primary-evidence-dc89/production-inventory-probe-result.json; script retained beside it. These are synthetic unit fixtures, not real UI evidence or independent receipts. Root actual13-asset dc89 binding remains separately verified.
findings.fix: Require exact complete emitted dist file set before checking hashes, including imported chunks/inspection/manifest/assets. Add negative omitted/extra/unbound consumed-asset tests using actual helper; preserve ERROR classification.

findings.summary: Dashboard growth crosses the file-size limit and enlarges the monolithic factory

finding.evidence: VoteView has only counts/power/total/threshold, and gauge() at lines105-128 renders no phase provenance. main.ts selects one record receipt at337-340/390 and supplies phase totals at471-482 without selected.preEvidence/attEvidence. In fresh served-dist Chromium and Firefox, preattestation at12:00:30 and attestation five seconds later both show600/30000; all disclosures opened still expose only selected receipt12:00:30 and age5s, with no attestation receipt. Durable independent diagnostic: /var/tmp/observatory-spec-evidence/phase-diagnostic03.json; decoded phase-chromium.json and phase-firefox.json. Diagnostic assertions establish the absence, so its success is defect reproduction, not spec acceptance.
finding.fix: Project each accepted phase current evidence with its original source/context/wall receipt and monotonic age into both LIVE and retained/frozen readers; retain phase-specific coverage qualification and honest missing evidence. Add genuine staggered pre/att, duplicate/enrichment and retained/frozen assertions without substituting candidate or head receipt.
